close_reason: Updated crate-level //! docstring to reference build_path_with_config and PathBuilderConfig::max_depth (default DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH = 10).
description:
pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs Algorithm doc, line 22:
  > [build_path] uses iterative-deepening DFS (RFC 4158 §2.5): it tries
  > increasing maximum path depths from 1 to 10 ...

After P3 commit ff707564 (PKIX-1uxb) added PathBuilderConfig + build_path_with_config, the constant '1 to 10' is no longer accurate when callers use the new entry point. The actual loop is `for max_depth in 1..=config.max_depth` (line 430). For build_path the bound is DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH=10, so the doc is true for that single function, but the crate-level Algorithm section reads as if 10 is hard-coded.

Fix: in the crate-level //! docstring, say 'depths from 1 up to PathBuilderConfig::max_depth (default DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH = 10)'.

Severity: P3 doc accuracy. Pass-1 attribution: a side effect of PKIX-1uxb that wasn't propagated to the crate-level prose.
title: P3: pkix-path-builder doc 'tries 1..10' is stale for build_path_with_config (depth comes from config)
